title: Charco Fervente
prompt:
Transparent ALPHA cutout, SQUARE canvas. SIMPLE FLAT 2D animated-comic illustration. Clean expressive varied-weight ink, loose energetic accents, broad SOLID COLOR SHAPES, discrete HARD CEL SHADOW BLOCKS, printed HALFTONE DOT patches. Warm ochre/rust/browns balanced with cool muted blue/cyan/deep green. No realistic painting, 3D, gradients, airbrush or neon. Whole subject fully inside canvas with empty transparent margin, no text or watermark.
Isolated environment VIGNETTE CUTOUT, compact irregular ground patch and structures. SKY AND EXTERIOR ARE FULLY TRANSPARENT. Environment can be wider than tall but canvas remains SQUARE. Keep the described activity and crowds when specified as small fully dressed human background figures. No opaque atmospheric backdrop or full screen landscape. Simplify details into bold graphic shapes.
RPG catalogue 148 Charco Fervente. EXACT SUBJECT: Charco Fervente: pântano que ferve, poças de lama borbulhando entre lajes de pedra que sobem e afundam, vapor prateado. Sinais de magia prata-mercúrio no ar.
Magic: flat uniform/overflowing aura with gaps, smoke wisps or hard-light constructs and printed dots. Value colors: Conflitüo rust red; Sublimeyn mercury silver; Dominum dark purple; Persona coral; Alvorum gold/black; Morbidyum pale green; Cognitium indigo; Eternyr midnight blue/white streaks; Primitivum moss green/amber. Metal when appropriate is dark golden Bronze Arco drawn in flat tones. Non-graphic fantasy, no gore or victims, no sexualized people.
